Name: Desert Shortcut
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

[size=3]So this is a shortcut to the desert, where you can go by walking or riding a horse in just 2 maps, all maps have forage and there is an additional map that has forage, wood and regenerating hardwood logs, you can also fish for iridium quality desert fish, because there is a nice big pond in the map before the desert and in the others you will fish for mountain fish, They are very well-kept and relaxing maps, and it is very useful at the beginning of the game for materials.I know there were already mods to go to the desert by walking, but I created this shortcut to the desert for convenience, because I don't like fighting and I don't like leaving the horse to take the bus, for this reason the map before the desert has a magic warp that takes you back to the starting point on your horse, so even if you haven't bought the flute yet you never have to leave your horse to go back earlier.
All recolors should be compatible and since it only adds a few tiles to the vanilla maps it should have high compatibility with many mods.

Added another entrance to the desert, added a map that connects the deep forest to the bus stop through a cave, in this cave you can plant  like in a greenhouse, you can recharge your energy by taking a bath and also put barrels to age.[/size]
[size=3]If you have installed the previous version and are experiencing problems with the bushes you will need the Reset Terrain Features mod.[/size]
Version 1.0.6 Added a seed shop for convenience, it is open from 7am to 9pm.

[size=3][size=3]Installation: Unzip and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size][/size]
